title: 14-BCV-007 - Interior stairways for roof access
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide, as stated by the STANDATA)
catalogue_status: Catalogue row is not marked [WITHDRAWN]; PDF carries an Archived watermark.

facts.text: The STANDATA addresses alternate access for roof access required by ABC Articles 3.2.5.3 and 3.6.4.7.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-007 PDF, pp.1-2, PURPOSE and CODE REFERENCES

facts.text: It lists fixed industrial/ship’s ladders, suitable folding stairs and rung-type fixed ladders; its stated maximum vertical height for the first two types is 3.7 m, and different access methods require a landing.
facts.locator: 14-BCV-007 PDF, p.2, VARIANCE; p.3, APPENDIX A
